sections.thesis: Valuation distrust, perceived unfairness and frictionless access turn investing into a social feedback loop.
sections.heroConcept: A margin contract crosses from the Korea Discount into a phone feed where each reaction triggers another order.
sections.visualContrastFromPreviousSection: Leave the cost ledger for distrust, contested rules and an accelerating screen-driven feed.

sections.sourceMarker: Và khi mà ba thứ đấy xuất hiện cùng một lúc
sections.thesis: CFD and regulation show that suppressing a product displaces speculative demand rather than removing it.
sections.heroConcept: A CFD contract hides its risk bearer, then speculative demand flows around the regulatory barrier.
sections.visualContrastFromPreviousSection: Replace social-feed overload with a procedural contract trail and a legible rerouting metaphor.

sections.sourceMarker: Nhưng mà tất cả những gì mà chúng ta vừa nói ở trên ấy
sections.thesis: Systemic pressure becomes personal, and short-term wins reinforce false mastery until the cycle repeats.
sections.heroConcept: A 28-year-old faces the distant home, wins once on leverage and mistakes the rebound for mastery.
sections.visualContrastFromPreviousSection: Return from offshore systems to one person, one home and one dangerously convincing win.
